prompt:
SCENE: Edo night alley, 16:9. Locked three-quarter on a wooden shoulder-yoke soba stall, no wheels. One paper andon glows. A boiling pot sits in the stall. An adult vendor, thirties, wears a kasa; the face stays hidden under the brim. No second face. No readable writing on the noren or lantern.

ACTION: Steam rolls off the pot and crosses the lens in one slow sheet, then thins. The vendor does not look up. No pour into a bowl. No customer stepping in.

FOCUS: Tack-sharp on the steam edge, the pot rim, and the andon paper. The alley boards are one stop soft.

PHYSICS: Steam is hot and wet. It drifts, then fades. It does not look like dry ice or a fog machine. No CGI ribbons.

LIGHT: The andon is the only warm key. Cool wet night around it. Specular on the broth only.

STYLE: Photoreal cinematic, period Japan, wood smoke and oil-paper glow, soft grain. No anime. No text. No watermark. No logos.

AUDIO: Diegetic SFX only. No music. No score. No singing. No speech. No narration. No vendor call. Soft boil and a wet steam hiss as the sheet crosses the lens. Distant night alley air.

translations.zh:
场景：江户雨夜小巷，16:9。固定机位三分之四侧面拍摄无轮木制肩挑荞麦面摊。一盏纸制行灯亮着。摊位上有口沸腾的锅。三十多岁的成年小贩戴着笠帽，脸被帽檐遮掩。没有第二张面孔。暖帘或灯笼上无清晰文字。

动作：热气从锅中滚滚升起，呈薄雾状缓慢掠过镜头后散去。摊贩不抬头，不向碗中盛汤，也没有顾客靠近。

对焦：精准对焦在蒸汽边缘、锅缘和行灯纸面上。巷道木板虚化一档。

物理效果：蒸汽滚烫潮湿，漂移随后消散，非干冰或造雾机效果，无CGI丝带感。

光照：行灯是唯一暖色主光。周围夜色冷湿。仅在肉汤上有高光。

风格：真实电影质感，日本时代剧，柴烟与油纸微光，柔和胶片颗粒。无动漫、文字、水印或标识。

音频：仅环境音效。无音乐、配乐、歌声、说话、旁白或摊贩叫卖。蒸汽掠过镜头时伴有轻微沸腾与湿润咝咝声。远处夜巷空气声。
